start: Gym with 2 branches; a file with a Branch column

steps.action: Choose the file
user_sees: Card 'Branches in your file'
'Your file has a column with each member’s branch. Check that each name goes to the right branch.'
A box for each name: '“<name>” · <n> rows'
'<branch>: <n> to add · <branch>: <n> to add'
must_not: A Branch box shown to a gym with one branch

steps.action: Wait for the other branch to open
user_sees: 'Opening <branch>… The Add button works once it is open.'
must_not: Rows checked for repeats only against the branch on screen

steps.action: Tap the Add button and wait
user_sees: A line for each branch: '<branch>: <n> members added.'
'Each branch has its own “Past imports” list on this page. To undo what went into another branch, switch to that branch and open this page there.'
must_not: A member saved into the wrong branch
A member saved into both branches

start: Gym with 2 branches; a file with no Branch column (another kind of file)

steps.action: Choose the file
user_sees: Card 'Branch' with the box 'Add the members in this sheet to'
The branch on screen is picked, or the branch whose name the sheet carries
must_not: Rows sent to another branch without the box saying so

steps.action: Pick the other branch
user_sees: 'Opening <branch>… The Add button works once it is open.'
With several sheets: 'One sheet for each branch? Pick the branch for this sheet. When it is added, you can add the next sheet.'
must_not: The Add button working before that branch is open

steps.action: Tap the Add button and wait
user_sees: '<branch>: <n> members added.'
must_not: The members added to the branch on screen instead

start: Gym with 2 branches; a file whose Branch column has a name no branch has

steps.action: Choose the file
user_sees: '1 name matches none of your branches. Pick a branch for it, or pick “Skip these rows”. Until then, those rows wait under “Rows to check”.'
Under the box: 'Pick a branch for these rows.'
must_not: Those rows added to the branch on screen without asking

steps.action: The other branch cannot be opened (no internet)
user_sees: 'Could not open <branch>: <reason> Its rows wait under “Rows to check”.'
Button 'Try to open <branch> again'
must_not: Rows for that branch saved somewhere else
The Add button stuck for ever

start: Gym with 2 branches; the Branches in your file card is open

steps.action: Pick 'Skip these rows' for one name, then change it to a branch
user_sees: The rows leave the list, then come back under that branch with the counts changed
must_not: Skipped rows added
The counts per branch not changing

steps.action: Tap the Add button; one branch fails to open while saving
user_sees: '<branch> could not be opened: <reason> Its rows are waiting below. Tap “Try again”.'
The other branch's line shows its members added
must_not: The good branch rolled back
The failed branch shown as done

steps.action: Tap 'Try again'
user_sees: Only the waiting rows are sent, into the right branch
must_not: Members of the good branch added twice
